skeleton.name: MPFB2 game_engine (Unreal-mannequin names) + eye_l, eye_r
skeleton.axes: glTF: +Y up, the character faces +Z, metres

tint.convention: the top garment is its own primitive with a material named `tint_top` (extras.tint = "top"). Its texture there is neutral light grey with the cloth shading only; multiply it by a club colour with material.color.set(colour). The exported colour is just a default.

face.morphTargets: ARKit face units (52 names, MPFB faceunits01, CC0) and Meta/Oculus visemes (viseme_*, MPFB visemes02, CC0), on Head, Lashes, Brows, Teeth, Tongue; set the same influence by name on every mesh that has it
face.eyes: bones eye_l and eye_r turn the eyeballs; the eyeLook* morphs move the lids with them

clips.name: idle
clips.what: standing: breathing and a slow shift of weight

clips.name: walk
clips.what: one captured stride, in place (CMU mocap, averaged)

clips.name: run
clips.what: one captured running stride, in place (CMU mocap, averaged)

clips.name: carry
clips.what: the captured walk with both arms holding a box

clips.name: turn
clips.what: a quarter turn to the left on the spot (Root bone turns 90 degrees)

clips.name: talk_3
clips.what: talking: a shrug, then pointing ahead

clips.name: cheer
clips.what: both fists up, bouncing: a goal

clips.name: sit
clips.what: stand to seated (seat at knee height), then held

clips.name: crouch_to_child
clips.what: down on one knee to a child's eye level, then held

clips.name: hand_on_shoulder
clips.what: right hand out and down onto the shoulder of a child standing at the right side, then held

clips.name: hug
clips.what: both arms round someone in front, then held

assets.tracks: bone rotations (parent space) for every bone, and the position of `pelvis` only; scale the pelvis position by character.hipHeight / clips.hipHeight

sources.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, mocap.cs.cmu.edu, BVH conversion by B. Hahne (cgspeed); via public/life/town/mocap.json
